    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理(11.MCP：为什么 AI 世界需要统一的工具协议？)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="hyq40p" data-start="271" data-end="301">第十一章 MCP：为什么 AI 世界需要统一的工具协议？</h1>
<hr data-start="303" data-end="306">
<h2 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">目录</h2>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<h2 data-section-id="cxuaum" data-start="308" data-end="315">本章导读</h2>
<p data-start="317" data-end="346">上一章，我们介绍了 Tool Calling（工具调用）。</p>
<p data-start="348" data-end="372">它让大语言模型第一次拥有了与现实世界交互的能力。</p>
<p data-start="374" data-end="377">例如：</p>
<ul data-start="379" data-end="426">
<li data-section-id="19k4895" data-start="379" data-end="386">查询天气；</li>
<li data-section-id="zn0jju" data-start="387" data-end="395">搜索互联网；</li>
<li data-section-id="1kalzf0" data-start="396" data-end="408">执行 Python；</li>
<li data-section-id="5q0oop" data-start="409" data-end="417">查询数据库；</li>
<li data-section-id="la793o" data-start="418" data-end="426">控制浏览器。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="428" data-end="470">这些能力让 AI 从一个"只会聊天"的模型，逐渐变成一个能够完成任务的 Agent。</p>
<p data-start="472" data-end="500">但是，当社区中越来越多工具出现之后，一个新的问题开始暴露出来。</p>
<p data-start="472" data-end="500"><strong data-start="504" data-end="537">如果每个 AI 平台都要重新开发一套工具接口，会发生什么？</strong></p>
<p data-start="539" data-end="576">这正是 MCP（Model Context Protocol）诞生的原因。</p>
<hr data-start="578" data-end="581">
<h1 data-section-id="cbe4q3" data-start="583" data-end="620">11.1 Tool Calling 已经很好了，为什么还需要 MCP？</h1>
<p data-start="622" data-end="635">我们还是以一个例子作为开始。</p>
<p data-start="637" data-end="652">假设你开发了一个天气查询工具。(其实也是大多数兄弟tool calling的开始..)</p>
<p data-start="654" data-end="665">它提供一个简单的接口：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;<code>查询天气（城市）</code></div>
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>现在，你希望它能够被不同的大模型使用。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="710" data-end="713">例如：</p>
<ul data-start="715" data-end="762">
<li data-section-id="6gc00l" data-start="715" data-end="724">ChatGPT</li>
<li data-section-id="1uzzumq" data-start="725" data-end="733">Claude</li>
<li data-section-id="1xg91op" data-start="734" data-end="742">Gemini</li>
<li data-section-id="1vbt2de" data-start="743" data-end="751">MinMax</li>
<li data-section-id="yblxr9" data-start="752" data-end="762">Qwen</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="764" data-end="782">理论上，它们都可以调用这个天气接口。</p>
<p data-start="784" data-end="794">但是现实却不是这样。</p>
<p data-start="796" data-end="812">每个平台都有自己的工具调用格式。</p>
<p data-start="814" data-end="825">例如（以下仅为示意,不代表最新的交互协议）：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">

↓

Function Calling
↓

你的天气工具</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">

<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Claude
↓

Tool Use
↓

你的天气工具</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Gemini
↓

Function Declaration
↓

你的天气工具</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>虽然最终调用的是同一个天气 API，但每个平台都有自己的接口规范、参数格式和通信方式。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1019" data-end="1035">于是，一个非常尴尬的问题出现了。</p>
<p data-start="1037" data-end="1062">如果你想同时支持五个平台，就需要分别适配五套接口。</p>
<p data-start="1064" data-end="1078">这就像我们前些年的手机充电器一样：</p>
<ul data-start="1080" data-end="1145">
<li data-section-id="1nsjpu6" data-start="1091" data-end="1100">安卓一种接口；</li>
<li data-section-id="1klqfa5" data-start="1101" data-end="1110">苹果一种接口；</li>
<li data-section-id="e2juhy" data-start="1111" data-end="1128">Micro USB 一种接口；</li>
<li data-section-id="l0fxf4" data-start="1129" data-end="1145">Type-C 又是一种接口。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1147" data-end="1162">明明都是充电，却没有统一标准。</p>
<hr data-start="1164" data-end="1167">
<h1 data-section-id="19hf3lx" data-start="1169" data-end="1196">11.2 Tool Calling 的局限在哪里？</h1>
<p data-start="1198" data-end="1206">上一章我们提到：</p>
<p data-start="1208" data-end="1226">Tool Calling 的本质是：<strong data-start="1230" data-end="1253">模型告诉程序："我需要调用这个工具。"</strong></p>
<p data-start="1255" data-end="1258">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div>
<div class="relative">
<div>
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>{
  "tool": <span class="ͼk">"weather",
  "city": <span class="ͼk">"北京"
}</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1313" data-end="1320">程序收到之后会按下面的流程进行操作</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>调用天气 API
↓

获得天气数据
↓

再交给 LLM</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;整个流程没有任何问题。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1378" data-end="1383">但是问题在于&nbsp;<strong data-start="1385" data-end="1427">Tool Calling 更像是模型厂商提供的一种能力，而不是一种统一标准。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1429" data-end="1432">例如：</p>
<p data-start="1434" data-end="1441">OpenAI：有自己的 Function Calling。</p>
<p data-start="1467" data-end="1477">Anthropic：有自己的 Tool Use。</p>
<p data-start="1495" data-end="1502">Google：有自己的 Function Declaration。</p>
<p data-start="1532" data-end="1539">不同平台之间：</p>
<ul data-start="1541" data-end="1583">
<li data-section-id="122oq49" data-start="1541" data-end="1553">Tool 定义不同；</li>
<li data-section-id="4n3n9v" data-start="1554" data-end="1563">参数格式不同；</li>
<li data-section-id="122mj6z" data-start="1564" data-end="1573">返回格式不同；</li>
<li data-section-id="8wk9ba" data-start="1574" data-end="1583">通信方式不同。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1585" data-end="1590">这意味着：</p>
<p data-start="1592" data-end="1613"><strong data-start="1592" data-end="1613">工具开发者需要不断重复开发适配层。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1615" data-end="1618">
<h1 data-section-id="11ksifb" data-start="1620" data-end="1639">11.3 MCP 想解决什么问题？</h1>
<p data-start="1641" data-end="1657">MCP 并没有发明一种新的工具,它只是定义了一套协议。</p>
<p data-start="1659" data-end="1667">它真正解决的是：<strong data-start="1671" data-end="1707">如何让工具只开发一次，就能够被所有支持 MCP 的 AI 使用。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1709" data-end="1721">可以把 MCP 理解成：<strong data-start="1725" data-end="1745">AI 与工具之间的一种通用语言。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1747" data-end="1778">注意，这里的"语言"并不是自然语言，而是一套约定好的通信协议。</p>
<p data-start="1780" data-end="1783">只要：</p>
<ul data-start="1785" data-end="1813">
<li data-section-id="115i8al" data-start="1785" data-end="1800">Agent 能按照 MCP调用；</li>
<li data-section-id="j83vjd" data-start="1801" data-end="1813">工具也能按照 MCP实现；</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1815" data-end="1838">那么它们就可以互相通信，而不需要关心对方是谁。</p>
<hr data-start="1840" data-end="1843">
<h1 data-section-id="fge2ao" data-start="1845" data-end="1860">11.4&nbsp;<strong data-start="2056" data-end="2077">MCP 是 AI 世界的 USB?</strong></h1>
<p data-start="1862" data-end="1874">还是举个例子.</p>
<p data-start="1862" data-end="1874">假设你买了一把无线鼠标。</p>
<p data-start="1876" data-end="1879">以前不同品牌都有自己的接收器。</p>
<p data-start="1896" data-end="1899">后来USB 成为了统一标准。</p>
<p data-start="1915" data-end="1918">于是无论罗技、雷蛇、戴尔、都可以直接插在你的电脑上。</p>
<p data-start="1957" data-end="1966">电脑并不需要知道,这是哪家公司生产的鼠标。</p>
<p data-start="1982" data-end="1985">因为 USB 已经规定好了通信方式。</p>
<p data-start="2025" data-end="2040">不过，这里有一点需要特别强调。</p>
<p data-start="2042" data-end="2052">网上很多文章都会说：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2054" data-end="2077">
<p data-start="2056" data-end="2077"><strong data-start="2056" data-end="2077">MCP 是 AI 世界的 USB。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2079" data-end="2096">这个比喻虽然便于理解，但并不完全准确。</p>
<p data-start="2098" data-end="2132">USB 是一种<strong data-start="2105" data-end="2115">硬件接口标准</strong>，解决的是设备之间的物理连接问题。</p>
<p data-start="2134" data-end="2184">而 MCP 是一种<strong data-start="2143" data-end="2154">应用层通信协议</strong>，解决的是 AI 与工具之间如何交换能力、请求和结果的问题。</p>
<p data-start="2186" data-end="2199">因此，更准确的类比应该是：<strong data-start="2203" data-end="2237">MCP 其实更像 HTTP协议或者数据库连接协议，而不是 USB 接口。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="2286" data-end="2289">
<h1 data-section-id="1kch3xq" data-start="2291" data-end="2309">11.5 MCP 架构长什么样？</h1>
<p data-start="2311" data-end="2325">我们来看一张简化后的架构图。</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>             AI Agent
                 │
                 ▼
          MCP Client（客户端）
                 │
         MCP 通信协议
                 │
                 ▼
          MCP Server（服务端）
        ┌────────┼────────┐
        ▼        ▼        ▼
      浏览器    数据库    Git</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2607" data-end="2622">这里第一次出现了两个新的角色,&nbsp;<strong data-start="2624" data-end="2638">MCP Client</strong>和<strong data-start="2643" data-end="2657">MCP Server.</strong></p>
<p data-start="2659" data-end="2671">最早,我们很容易混淆它们。</p>
<p data-start="2673" data-end="2686">但是,其实它们的职责其实非常明确。</p>
<hr data-start="2688" data-end="2691">
<h1 data-section-id="1d2c1oh" data-start="2693" data-end="2715">11.6 MCP Client 是什么？</h1>
<p data-start="2717" data-end="2727">Client其实就是：<strong data-start="2731" data-end="2745">主动发起请求的一方。</strong></p>
<p data-start="2747" data-end="2750">它通常是LLM或者Agent,比如</p>
<p data-start="2752" data-end="2767">Claude Desktop；</p>
<p data-start="2769" data-end="2778">OpenClaw；</p>
<p data-start="2780" data-end="2787">Cursor；</p>
<p data-start="2789" data-end="2801">Claude Code；</p>
<p data-start="2803" data-end="2809">Codex；</p>
<p data-start="2811" data-end="2835">这些 AI 应用，都可以充当 MCP Client。</p>
<p data-start="2837" data-end="2842">它们负责：</p>
<ul data-start="2844" data-end="2888">
<li data-section-id="15etx83" data-start="2844" data-end="2860">连接 MCP Server；</li>
<li data-section-id="1su2p5r" data-start="2861" data-end="2870">获取工具列表；</li>
<li data-section-id="v5js6i" data-start="2871" data-end="2878">调用工具；</li>
<li data-section-id="14ra8b2" data-start="2879" data-end="2888">获取返回结果。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2890" data-end="2896">可以理解为<strong data-start="2900" data-end="2920">Client 等于使用工具的人。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="2922" data-end="2925">
<h1 data-section-id="19waqsc" data-start="2927" data-end="2949">11.7 MCP Server 是什么？</h1>
<p data-start="2951" data-end="2962">Server 则相反。</p>
<p data-start="2964" data-end="2968">它负责提供能力。</p>
<p data-start="2977" data-end="2980">比如,一个 Git MCP Server。</p>
<p data-start="3002" data-end="3007">它可以提供：</p>
<ul data-start="3009" data-end="3042">
<li data-section-id="apq964" data-start="3009" data-end="3021">查看 Commit；</li>
<li data-section-id="1i5gl46" data-start="3022" data-end="3034">创建 Branch；</li>
<li data-section-id="ylrejg" data-start="3035" data-end="3042">提交代码。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3044" data-end="3061">一个数据库 MCP Server。</p>
<p data-start="3063" data-end="3068">它可以提供：</p>
<ul data-start="3070" data-end="3095">
<li data-section-id="19dhdm2" data-start="3070" data-end="3077">查询数据；</li>
<li data-section-id="qls66y" data-start="3078" data-end="3085">修改数据；</li>
<li data-section-id="1rscg27" data-start="3086" data-end="3095">执行 SQL。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3097" data-end="3114">一个浏览器 MCP Server。</p>
<p data-start="3116" data-end="3121">它可以提供：</p>
<ul data-start="3123" data-end="3148">
<li data-section-id="1n320pw" data-start="3123" data-end="3130">打开网页；</li>
<li data-section-id="1oi486u" data-start="3131" data-end="3138">点击按钮；</li>
<li data-section-id="3jxfcw" data-start="3139" data-end="3148">获取页面内容。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3150" data-end="3153">所以<strong data-start="3157" data-end="3180">Server则是提供工具能力的一方。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3182" data-end="3232">一个 Server 可以提供多个 Tool，而一个 Client 也可以同时连接多个 Server。</p>
<hr data-start="3234" data-end="3237">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1jqdja7" data-start="83" data-end="103">11.8 MCP 的一次完整调用流程</h1>
<p data-start="105" data-end="136">简单了解了 MCP 的整体架构之后，我们再来看一次真实的调用过程。</p>
<p data-start="138" data-end="160">很多人第一次接触 MCP 时，会有一种误解：</p>
<blockquote data-start="162" data-end="203">
<p data-start="164" data-end="203"><strong data-start="164" data-end="203">是不是 Claude 或 ChatGPT 直接调用了我的 C# 方法？</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="205" data-end="212">实际上并不是。</p>
<p data-start="214" data-end="243">整个调用过程始终遵循"模型负责决策，程序负责执行"的原则。</p>
<p data-start="245" data-end="276">下面以一个天气查询工具为例，看看一次完整的 MCP 调用过程。</p>
<p data-start="278" data-end="317">假设我们开发了一个 MCP Server，其中提供了一个查询天气的 Tool：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>QueryWeather(city)</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="351" data-end="363">用户向 AI 提出问题：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>武汉今天的天气怎么样？</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="390" data-end="404">整个系统会经历下面几个步骤。</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 用户输入                                 │
│ "武汉今天的天气怎么样？"                  │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ LLM 分析用户意图                          │
│ 判断需要调用 QueryWeather Tool            │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ MCP Client                               │
│ 向 MCP Server 发送 tools/call 请求        │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ MCP Server                               │
│ 执行 QueryWeather("武汉")                 │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 返回结果                                 │
│ 晴天，30℃，东南风三级                     │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ LLM 根据工具结果组织自然语言              │
└──────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                   │
                   ▼
            回复最终答案</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1671" data-end="1693">整个过程中，大模型始终没有直接执行任何代码。</p>
<p data-start="1695" data-end="1705">它只完成了两件事情：</p>
<ol data-start="1707" data-end="1741">
<li data-section-id="zah8pl" data-start="1707" data-end="1721">判断是否需要调用工具；</li>
<li data-section-id="2sdeuy" data-start="1722" data-end="1741">根据工具返回的数据生成最终回复。</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="1743" data-end="1765">真正执行查询天气的是 MCP Server。</p>
<p data-start="1767" data-end="1773">因此可以说：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1775" data-end="1810">
<p data-start="1777" data-end="1810"><strong data-start="1777" data-end="1810">MCP 负责连接工具，LLM 负责理解语言，两者各司其职。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1812" data-end="1815">
<h2 data-section-id="1sb9rbr" data-start="1817" data-end="1829">MCP 初始化过程</h2>
<p data-start="1831" data-end="1845">很多兄弟可能还会有一个疑问：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1847" data-end="1873">
<p data-start="1849" data-end="1873">LLM 是怎么知道有哪些 Tool 可以调用的？</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1875" data-end="1892">答案其实就在 MCP 的初始化过程中。</p>
<p data-start="1894" data-end="1948">当 Client 第一次连接 MCP Server 时，就会自动获取 Server 所提供的能力。</p>
<p data-start="1950" data-end="1966">整个过程可以简化为下面几个步骤：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Client
    │
    │ initialize
    ▼
Server
    │
    │ 返回协议版本、Server 信息
    ▼
Client
    │
    │ tools/list
    ▼
Server
    │
    ├── QueryWeather
    ├── SearchOrder
    ├── GetInventory
    └── GenerateReport</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2193" data-end="2211">完成这一步之后，其实这些能力就已经在LLM的上下文对话中了,这时候LLM 就已经知道：<strong data-start="2215" data-end="2235">当前有哪些 Tool 可以使用。</strong></p>
<p data-start="2237" data-end="2289">之后，当用户提出问题时，模型会根据 Tool 的名称、说明以及参数定义，自主决定是否调用某个 Tool。</p>
<p data-start="2291" data-end="2332">整个过程并不需要开发人员编写任何"如果用户问天气，就调用天气接口"这样的业务代码。</p>
<p data-start="2334" data-end="2358">这也是 MCP 与传统 API 最大的不同之处。</p>
<h1 data-section-id="1ujdtfj" data-start="3239" data-end="3264">&nbsp;</h1>
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="16j8s09" data-start="168" data-end="201">11.9 使用 .NET 开发一个简单的 MCP Server</h1>
<p data-start="203" data-end="239">理解了 MCP 的工作原理之后，我们再来看一个最简单的 .NET 示例。</p>
<p data-start="241" data-end="333">对于 .NET 开发者来说，一个好消息是：<strong data-start="262" data-end="285">目前已经有官方的 MCP C# SDK</strong>，开发者无需自己实现 JSON-RPC 协议、Tool 注册或通信逻辑，只需要关注业务代码即可。</p>
<p data-start="335" data-end="462">目前推荐使用 <strong data-start="342" data-end="376">ModelContextProtocol 官方 C# SDK</strong>，它由 <strong data-start="380" data-end="405">Anthropic 与 Microsoft</strong> 共同推动维护，是 MCP 官方组织提供的 .NET 实现，也是目前 .NET 平台开发 MCP 应用的推荐方案。</p>
<p data-start="464" data-end="469">官方地址：</p>
<ul data-start="471" data-end="616">
<li data-section-id="pe4y7o" data-start="471" data-end="515">GitHub：<strong data-start="480" data-end="515">modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk</strong></li>
<li data-section-id="1vtt2av" data-start="516" data-end="559">官方文档：<strong data-start="523" data-end="559"><a class="decorated-link" href="https://modelcontextprotocol.io/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_new" data-start="525" data-end="557">https://modelcontextprotocol.io/</a></strong></li>
<li data-section-id="eth63d" data-start="560" data-end="616">API 文档：<strong data-start="569" data-end="616"><a class="decorated-link" href="https://csharp.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_new" data-start="571" data-end="614">https://csharp.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/</a></strong></li>
</ul>
<p data-start="618" data-end="749">整个 SDK 已经与 <strong data-start="629" data-end="673">Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection</strong>、<strong data-start="674" data-end="706">Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting</strong> 等 .NET 基础设施深度集成，因此开发体验与 ASP.NET Core 十分相似。</p>
<p data-start="751" data-end="782">对于绝大多数项目，只需要安装下面这两个 NuGet 包即可：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-4 top-12 bottom-4">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="relative">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0">dotnet add <span class="hljs-keyword">package <span class="hljs-title">ModelContextProtocol </span></span></pre>
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><span class="hljs-keyword"><span class="hljs-title">dotnet add <span class="hljs-keyword">package <span class="hljs-title">Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="837" data-end="866">安装完成之后，就可以开始开发自己的 MCP Server。</p>
<hr data-start="868" data-end="871">
<h2 data-section-id="1ihd7qh" data-start="873" data-end="893">第一步：注册 MCP Server</h2>
<p data-start="895" data-end="906">Program.cs：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ModelContextProtocol.Server;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> builder =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Host.CreateApplicationBuilder(args);

builder.Services
    .AddMcpServer()
    .WithStdioServerTransport()
    .WithToolsFromAssembly();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> builder.Build().RunAsync();</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1194" data-end="1218">这段代码与 ASP.NET Core 十分相似。</p>
<p data-start="1220" data-end="1253">整个 MCP Server 可以理解成一个普通的 Host 应用。</p>
<p data-start="1255" data-end="1272">其中几个扩展方法分别承担不同职责：</p>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="1274" data-end="1521">
<thead data-start="1274" data-end="1285">
<tr data-start="1274" data-end="1285"><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="1274" data-end="1279" data-col-size="sm">方法</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="1279" data-end="1285" data-col-size="md">作用</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="1302" data-end="1521">
<tr data-start="1302" data-end="1342">
<td data-start="1302" data-end="1321" data-col-size="sm"><code data-start="1304" data-end="1320">AddMcpServer()</code></td>
<td data-col-size="md" data-start="1321" data-end="1342">注册 MCP Server 服务。</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="1343" data-end="1452">
<td data-start="1343" data-end="1374" data-col-size="sm"><code data-start="1345" data-end="1373">WithStdioServerTransport()</code></td>
<td data-col-size="md" data-start="1374" data-end="1452">使用 STDIO（标准输入/输出）作为通信方式，适用于 Claude Desktop、OpenClaw、Claude Code 等本地 Agent。</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="1453" data-end="1521">
<td data-start="1453" data-end="1481" data-col-size="sm"><code data-start="1455" data-end="1480">WithToolsFromAssembly()</code></td>
<td data-col-size="md" data-start="1481" data-end="1521">自动扫描程序集中的 Tool，并完成注册，无需手工维护 Tool 列表。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1523" data-end="1582">可以看到，开发者几乎不用关心 MCP 协议本身，而是通过 SDK 提供的扩展方法快速完成整个 Server 的初始化。</p>
<hr data-start="1584" data-end="1587">
<h2 data-section-id="16svw6f" data-start="1589" data-end="1605">第二步：编写一个 Tool</h2>
<p data-start="1607" data-end="1658">完成 Server 注册之后，只需要编写一个普通的 C# 方法即可将其暴露给 AI Agent 调用。</p>
<p data-start="1660" data-end="1677">下面我们定义一个最简单的天气查询工具：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-4 top-12 bottom-4">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ModelContextProtocol.Server;

[McpServerToolType]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WeatherTool
{
    [McpServerTool, Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">查询各地区天气,可以调用这个接口</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> QueryWeather(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> city)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{city}：晴天，30℃</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="relative">
<div>对于开发者来说，一个 MCP Tool 本质上就是一个普通的方法。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1923" data-end="1933">SDK 会自动完成下面一系列操作：</p>
<ul data-start="1935" data-end="1987">
<li data-section-id="z21bfz" data-start="1935" data-end="1945">Tool 注册；</li>
<li data-section-id="12h3pgy" data-start="1946" data-end="1953">参数解析；</li>
<li data-section-id="mksbut" data-start="1954" data-end="1965">JSON 序列化；</li>
<li data-section-id="1556zo7" data-start="1966" data-end="1977">MCP 协议通信；</li>
<li data-section-id="8eas3v" data-start="1978" data-end="1987">返回结果封装。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1989" data-end="2012">开发者只需要关注业务逻辑，而无需处理协议细节。</p>
<hr data-start="2014" data-end="2017">
<h2 data-section-id="ezhgf4" data-start="2019" data-end="2036">MCP Tool 的调用过程</h2>
<p data-start="2038" data-end="2063">假设用户在 Claude Desktop 中输入：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2065" data-end="2082">
<p data-start="2067" data-end="2082"><strong data-start="2067" data-end="2082">武汉今天的天气怎么样？</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2084" data-end="2096">整个调用过程如下图所示：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Claude Desktop
        │
        ▼
LLM 判断需要调用 QueryWeather
        │
        ▼
MCP Client
        │
        ▼
MCP Server
        │
        ▼
WeatherTool.QueryWeather("武汉")
        │
        ▼
返回："武汉：晴天，30℃"
        │
        ▼
LLM 根据结果组织自然语言
        │
        ▼
回复用户</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2378" data-end="2404">整个过程中，大模型始终没有直接执行任何 C# 代码。</p>
<p data-start="2406" data-end="2426">真正执行代码的是 MCP Server。</p>
<p data-start="2428" data-end="2492">LLM 负责理解用户意图，并决定何时调用 Tool；MCP Server 负责完成具体业务逻辑，两者共同协作完成一次完整的任务。</p>
<hr data-start="2494" data-end="2497">
<h2 data-section-id="14gdvjr" data-start="2499" data-end="2539">知识拓展：MCP SDK 与 Semantic Kernel 是什么关系？</h2>
<p data-start="2541" data-end="2567">很多 .NET 开发者第一次接触 MCP 时都会问：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2569" data-end="2612">
<p data-start="2571" data-end="2612"><strong data-start="2571" data-end="2612">既然已经有 Semantic Kernel，为什么还需要 MCP SDK？</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2614" data-end="2637">实际上，两者并不是竞争关系，而是位于不同层次。</p>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="2639" data-end="2924">
<thead data-start="2639" data-end="2652">
<tr data-start="2639" data-end="2652"><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="2639" data-end="2644" data-col-size="sm">技术</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="2644" data-end="2652" data-col-size="md">主要职责</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="2673" data-end="2924">
<tr data-start="2673" data-end="2758">
<td data-start="2673" data-end="2695" data-col-size="sm"><strong data-start="2675" data-end="2694">Semantic Kernel</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md" data-start="2695" data-end="2758">AI 应用开发框架，负责 Prompt、Chat、Memory、Planner、Workflow 等 AI 能力编排。</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="2759" data-end="2844">
<td data-start="2759" data-end="2789" data-col-size="sm"><strong data-start="2761" data-end="2788">Microsoft.Extensions.AI</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md" data-start="2789" data-end="2844">对不同大模型提供统一抽象，屏蔽 OpenAI、Azure OpenAI、Ollama 等模型接口差异。</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="2845" data-end="2924">
<td data-start="2845" data-end="2879" data-col-size="sm"><strong data-start="2847" data-end="2878">ModelContextProtocol C# SDK</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md" data-start="2879" data-end="2924">实现 MCP 协议，负责 AI Agent 与 MCP Server 之间的通信。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2926" data-end="2939">它们之间的关系可以理解为：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>          Semantic Kernel
                  │
                  ▼
    Microsoft.Extensions.AI
                  │
                  ▼
ModelContextProtocol C# SDK
                  │
                  ▼
            MCP Server
                  │
                  ▼
      企业系统 / 数据库 / Web API</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3246" data-end="3260">三者分别解决不同层次的问题：</p>
<ul data-start="3262" data-end="3383">
<li data-section-id="tfxldu" data-start="3262" data-end="3298"><strong data-start="3264" data-end="3283">Semantic Kernel</strong> 负责组织 AI 的工作流程；</li>
<li data-section-id="1dxi5dt" data-start="3299" data-end="3340"><strong data-start="3301" data-end="3328">Microsoft.Extensions.AI</strong> 负责统一模型调用接口；</li>
<li data-section-id="fip3wx" data-start="3341" data-end="3383"><strong data-start="3343" data-end="3354">MCP SDK</strong> 则负责让 AI 能够安全、标准地访问外部工具和企业系统。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3385" data-end="3420">因此，在企业级 AI 应用中，这三者往往是协同工作的，而不是相互替代。</p>
<p data-start="3385" data-end="3420">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 data-section-id="1ujdtfj" data-start="3239" data-end="3264">11.10 为什么越来越多Agent产品开始支持 MCP？</h1>
<p data-start="3266" data-end="3289">因为对于产品平台来说，它解决了一个长期存在的问题：</p>
<p data-start="3291" data-end="3310">过去，每接入一种工具，都要做一次适配。</p>
<p data-start="3312" data-end="3367">现在，只要工具实现了 MCP Server，平台实现了 MCP Client，它们就可以按照统一协议进行通信。</p>
<p data-start="3369" data-end="3374">这意味着：</p>
<ul data-start="3376" data-end="3452">
<li data-section-id="1y0eubj" data-start="3376" data-end="3393">工具开发者只需要维护一套接口；</li>
<li data-section-id="2iu22v" data-start="3394" data-end="3414">AI 平台可以快速接入大量已有工具；</li>
<li data-section-id="gw4g6x" data-start="3415" data-end="3452">企业内部也可以把自己的系统封装成 MCP Server，对外提供能力。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3454" data-end="3494">因此，MCP 的价值不仅在于"方便开发"，更在于<strong data-start="3478" data-end="3493">降低生态之间的连接成本</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="3496" data-end="3499">
<h1 data-section-id="121tv7e" data-start="3501" data-end="3528">11.11 以 OpenClaw 为例</h1>
<p data-start="3556" data-end="3589">以今年以来比较火的&nbsp;<strong data-start="3558" data-end="3570">OpenClaw</strong> 为例，它本身并不会直接内置所有工具。</p>
<p data-start="3591" data-end="3629">相反，它可以作为一个 MCP Client，连接多个 MCP Server。</p>
<p data-start="3631" data-end="3634">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>OpenClaw
    │
    ├──────── 文件系统 MCP Server
    │
    ├──────── Git MCP Server
    │
    ├──────── PostgreSQL MCP Server
    │
    ├──────── Browser MCP Server
    │
    └──────── 企业内部 ERP MCP Server</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3850" data-end="3888">对于 OpenClaw 来说，它并不需要知道这些工具是谁开发的，只需要知道：</p>
<blockquote data-start="3890" data-end="3909">
<p data-start="3892" data-end="3909"><strong data-start="3892" data-end="3909">它们都遵循 MCP 协议。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3911" data-end="3943">这样，当模型需要某种能力时，就可以通过 MCP 调用对应的工具。</p>
<p data-start="3945" data-end="3978">这也是为什么近一年来，越来越多 Agent 框架开始支持 MCP。</p>
<hr data-start="3980" data-end="3983">
<h1 data-section-id="1mm2zvm" data-start="3985" data-end="3991">本章总结</h1>
<p data-start="3993" data-end="4007">这一章，我们回答了四个问题：</p>
<ol data-start="4009" data-end="4259">
<li data-section-id="mchoyz" data-start="4009" data-end="4068"><strong data-start="4012" data-end="4037">为什么 Tool Calling 还不够？</strong>
<ul data-start="4041" data-end="4068">
<li data-section-id="1xsubgj" data-start="4041" data-end="4068">因为各个平台都有自己的工具调用方式，生态彼此割裂。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="z3iy52" data-start="4070" data-end="4117"><strong data-start="4073" data-end="4089">MCP 想解决什么问题？</strong>
<ul data-start="4093" data-end="4117">
<li data-section-id="1jzz4qk" data-start="4093" data-end="4117">为 AI 与工具之间建立一套统一的通信协议。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="1ro1jz9" data-start="4119" data-end="4202"><strong data-start="4122" data-end="4156">MCP Client 和 MCP Server 分别是什么？</strong>
<ul data-start="4160" data-end="4202">
<li data-section-id="1oq7qpj" data-start="4160" data-end="4202">Client 发起调用，Server 提供能力，它们通过 MCP 协议进行通信。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="1mru5di" data-start="4204" data-end="4259"><strong data-start="4207" data-end="4225">为什么 MCP 越来越重要？</strong>
<ul data-start="4229" data-end="4259">
<li data-section-id="1tl41p8" data-start="4229" data-end="4259">它降低了工具接入成本，使不同平台能够共享同一套工具生态。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>

</div>
